title: File a Complaint or Commendation – Community Police Oversight
description: Use this 311 service request to submit a complaint or commendation regarding a member of the Dallas Police Department (DPD). *** FILE A COMPLAINT: If you wish to file a complaint against a DPD employee, please complete the complaint form HERE. If you are unsure of the officer’s name or badge number, please provide the date, time, and details of the incident so we can identify the officer(s) involved. *** COMMEND AN OFFICER: If you would like to recognize a DPD employee for outstanding service, please complete the commendation form HERE. NOTE: Criminal complaints against individuals who are not part of the Dallas Police Department must be filed directly with the Dallas Police Department. For those who would like to file a commendation or complaint in person or by mail, additional information is available on the OCPO website.

actions.tagline: Contact the Office of Community Police Oversight to file a complaint about a DPD employee.
actions.why: For a complaint about a Dallas Police Department employee. If you do not know the officer name or badge number, the complaint form asks for the incident date, time, and details so the officer can be identified.
actions.why_not: This complaint route does not apply to criminal complaints against people who are not Dallas Police Department members. If the complaint is against someone who is not a DPD member, then file it directly with the Dallas Police Department.
